CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_contract_child_trigger_v2()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ BEGIN IF NEW.kind='alpaca_option_bars' THEN PERFORM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_contract_register_child_v2(NEW.id);END IF;RETURN NEW;END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_contract_enqueue_v2(p_task text, p_page integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_contract_enumeration_v2(task_id,page_no,run_id)
 SELECT t.id,p_page,t.run_id FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 t JOIN astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_pages_v2 p ON p.task_id=t.id AND p.page_no=p_page
 WHERE t.id=p_task AND t.kind='alpaca_option_contracts' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_contract_key_v2(p_symbol text, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_feed text, p_timeframe text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array('Alpaca',p_symbol,extract(epoch FROM p_start),extract(epoch FROM p_end),p_feed,p_timeframe)::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
$function$
